text:
Asha Patel: Quick weekly pulse for CobaltHealth — bringing token + throughput signals. TL;DR: WoW token +18%, QoQ +42%, latency uptick, spend creeping up.
Diego Ramos: Seen the WoW bump, thanks. Error rate on chat.complete is ~5% over last 6h, mostly timeouts.
Marta Nguyen: I can confirm — KV cache miss rate spiked at 03:12 UTC after the small dedupe rollout. Misses correlate with latency tail.
Ethan Li: Heads up — billing alert triggered yesterday. Projected monthly spend if trend holds: +60% QoQ. Billing email sent to account.
Asha Patel: Renewal health: usage = strong (good), performance = degraded (medium risk), spend = rising (watch). Recommend enablement + architecture touchpoint this week.
Diego Ramos: Plan: roll a canary reverting the dedupe change and test with synthetic load. If errors drop, revert for a quick patch. I'll try a canary with `batch_max_tokens=512` and `kv_prefetch=false`.
Marta Nguyen: I'll tail logs and watch cache metrics. Quick command I'll use:
```
kubectl logs -l app=cobalt-health -c runtime --since=2h | grep "KV cache miss" | tail -n 50
```
Ethan Li: Finance asks for immediate mitigation to cap spend — can we set a soft TPS cap for the rest of the week? Even a temporary throttle is OK.
Diego Ramos: Affirmative. I'll add a route rule: `max_tps: 30` for CobaltHealth in the routing policy (can revert after we stabilize).
ops-bot: Incident created INC-2145 — CobaltHealth throughput/latency spike. Pager muted for CS; engineers notified. Link: https://redwood.inc/INC-2145
Asha Patel: Action items: (1) Diego revert-candidate canary + results in 2h, (2) Marta monitor cache misses and post graphs, (3) Ethan apply soft TPS cap and confirm billing projection updated, (4) CS enablement call Wed 10:00am PT to walk customer through burst model and cost tips.
Marta Nguyen: I'll upload a short chart in this thread when I see the first 30m of canary results.
Diego Ramos: Canary started 2145727256, running on 2 nodes. Synthetic QPS = 40 -> observing p95.
Ethan Li: TPS cap applied at 2145729000. Finance notified @Maya-Finance.
Asha Patel: Prep notes for the client: share sample prompt set that reduces token churn, recommend prefix caching, highlight rollback timeline. I'll draft and post here.
Diego Ramos: Early canary numbers: error rate down to 1.2%, p50 latency 150ms -> 130ms. Looks promising.
Marta Nguyen: Cache miss rate dropped ~70% in first 20m. Will keep monitoring for 12h.
Asha Patel: Great work — keeping renewal green if we hold these improvements. I'll update the account health dashboard and close the loop after the enablement call. :thumbsup:
